'''Wispeth''' was a [[Prince/Legends|princess]] in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. She was said to have been forced to knit clothes for the [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], and eventually rescued by the legendary hunter [[Romba (legend)|Romba]]. "Wispeth" was a popular name given to female Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as an [[Wispeth|Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="SWI 135">{{InsiderCite|135|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wispeth was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
